description: Extend AppRoutes.jsx and roleConfig.js (additive only — no deletions), then run the full build and fix any errors. Depends on FEAT-001, FEAT-002, FEAT-003 all being complete (all components must exist before they are imported).
steps: READ frontend/src/routes/AppRoutes.jsx in full before editing. Then ADD new import statements at the top of the existing import block (after the last Partner import, before the closing of the imports section). Import all 9 student components: SkillEvidenceHub, SkillGapPriority, CareerActionPlan, InternshipReadiness, DigitalTwin, CareerPathSimulator, DigitalPassport, ApplicationOutcomes, CompanyFeedback from '../components/dashboard/student/{Name}'. Import all 3 partner components: CompletionWorkflow, FeedbackForm (note: not used directly in routes), CertificateWorkflow from '../components/dashboard/partner/{Name}'. Import 2 admin components: CertificateManagement, CareerIntelligenceInsights from '../components/dashboard/admin/{Name}'. Import 1 public page: CertificateVerification from '../pages/CertificateVerification'. Do NOT import FeedbackForm as a route — it's a sub-component. Total new route imports: 9 + 2 + 2 + 1 = 14 components.

ADD new Route elements to AppRoutes.jsx (inside the existing Route blocks — do NOT restructure or remove existing routes). Inside the existing '<Route path="/dashboard" element={<StudentDashboard />}>' block, add after the last existing Route: <Route path='skills/evidence' element={<SkillEvidenceHub />} />, <Route path='skills/gaps' element={<SkillGapPriority />} />, <Route path='career/action-plan' element={<CareerActionPlan />} />, <Route path='career/readiness' element={<InternshipReadiness />} />, <Route path='career/digital-twin' element={<DigitalTwin />} />, <Route path='career/paths' element={<CareerPathSimulator />} />, <Route path='passport' element={<DigitalPassport />} />, <Route path='applications/outcomes' element={<ApplicationOutcomes />} />, <Route path='feedback' element={<CompanyFeedback />} />. Inside '<Route path="/partner/dashboard"...>' block: <Route path='completion' element={<CompletionWorkflow />} />, <Route path='certificates' element={<CertificateWorkflow />} />. Inside '<Route path="/admin/dashboard"...>' block: <Route path='certificates' element={<CertificateManagement />} />, <Route path='career-insights' element={<CareerIntelligenceInsights />} />. At the TOP-LEVEL Routes (before the catch-all): <Route path='/certificate/verify/:certificateId' element={<CertificateVerification />} />.

READ frontend/src/utils/roleConfig.js in full before editing. Then ADD new icon names to the existing lucide-react import: ShieldCheck, Target, ListChecks, Gauge, BookOpen, CheckCircle2, Award, TrendingUp. These 8 names must be appended to the existing import destructure — do NOT replace the existing imports. Verify each name: ShieldCheck✓, Target✓, ListChecks✓, Gauge✓, BookOpen✓, CheckCircle2✓, Award✓, TrendingUp✓ (all confirmed present in lucide-react v0.363.0).

ADD new menuItems to roleConfig.js. Student section: after the {path:'/dashboard/analytics'...} entry, add: {path:'/dashboard/skills/evidence', label:'Skill Evidence', icon:ShieldCheck}, {path:'/dashboard/skills/gaps', label:'Skill Gaps', icon:Target}, {path:'/dashboard/career/action-plan', label:'Action Plan', icon:ListChecks}, {path:'/dashboard/career/readiness', label:'Readiness', icon:Gauge}, {path:'/dashboard/passport', label:'My Passport', icon:BookOpen}. Partner section: before the {path:'/partner/dashboard/analytics'...} entry, add: {path:'/partner/dashboard/completion', label:'Completion', icon:CheckCircle2}, {path:'/partner/dashboard/certificates', label:'Certificates', icon:Award}. Admin section (menuItems array for 'admin'): before the {path:'/admin/dashboard/analytics'...} entry, add: {path:'/admin/dashboard/certificates', label:'Certificates', icon:Award}, {path:'/admin/dashboard/career-insights', label:'Career Insights', icon:TrendingUp}. Super_admin section: same additions as admin. DO NOT remove or reorder existing items.

Run the build: cd 'd:\my code\my project\NEO GEN INTERNSHIP ENGINE/frontend' && npm run build 2>&1. Read the full output. If there are errors: (a) Missing module errors — check the import path and filename match exactly (case-sensitive on Linux but case-insensitive on Windows; keep paths exact as specified). (b) Icon name errors — verify against lucide-react/dist/esm/icons/index.js. (c) JSX syntax errors in new files — fix the specific file. (d) 'X is not a default export' — ensure default export exists. Re-run build after each fix batch until build succeeds with exit 0.
After build succeeds, commit all new and modified files with message: 'feat: career intelligence UI — components, pages, routes, nav config'.
acceptance_criteria: AppRoutes.jsx has all 14 new imports and all new Route elements without any existing route removed.
roleConfig.js has 8 new icon imports and all new menuItems in the correct sections without any existing item removed.
npm run build from frontend/ completes with exit 0.
No existing component, route, or nav item is missing after the edits.
verification: cd 'd:\my code\my project\NEO GEN INTERNSHIP ENGINE/frontend' && npm run build 2>&1
